scripts.swagger: docker compose -f ../../docker-compose.yml run --rm api sh -c "go run github.com/swaggo/swag/cmd/swag@v1.16.4 init -g cmd/server/main.go -o docs --parseDependency --parseInternal && go mod vendor"
scripts.test: docker compose -f ../../docker-compose.yml run --rm api go test -mod=vendor ./... -race -cover
scripts.typecheck: docker compose -f ../../docker-compose.yml run --rm api go vet ./...
